title: Derived tensor comparison for arbitrary ringed topoi
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be sites with sheaves of commutative rings $R,S$, and let $u:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ be a morphism of topoi, meaning an adjunction $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ whose left adjoint preserves finite limits. Equip it with a ring map $u^{-1}R\to S$. Write $D(R)$ and $D(S)$ for the unbounded derived categories of the abelian categories of sheaves of modules over these rings [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Module pullback is $u^*M=S\otimes_{u^{-1}R}u^{-1}M$, using the sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]; $Lu^*:D(R)\to D(S)$ is its total left derived functor, computed by applying $u^*$ to K-flat resolutions with flat terms [def-pc-kflat-complex, lem-pc-kflat-resolution]. Here a sheaf of modules is flat when tensoring with it is exact. If $P$ is K-flat with flat terms, then $u^*P$ is K-flat with flat terms. Derived tensor is computed by the total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] of K-flat resolutions. For all $F,G\in D(R)$ there is a canonical isomorphism
$$
 Lu^*(F\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}G)
 \xrightarrow{\sim}Lu^*F\otimes_S^{\mathbf L}Lu^*G
$$
in $D(S)$, natural simultaneously in $F$ and $G$.
